about_the_game:
This demo features the introductory area of Kitten Force: Survivor and allows you to experience the beginning of the game's battles. You will face the first enemy waves, including bosses encounters, while choosing upgrades and power-ups each turn to build the best possible strategy. The combat and progression systems are already present, but with some limitations specific to the demo version.

The demo includes only one playable character, a single tower available for placement, and is limited to four weapons. The content is restricted to the early areas of the game, and progress will not carry over to the full version. The complete game will feature more characters, more weapons, a wider variety of towers, additional enemies, full stages, and an expanded progression system.

Strategic Wave Combat

Get ready for an intense experience! You will face waves of enemies that become increasingly challenging. Each match is a new test of your intelligence and strategy, where you must adapt, make quick decisions, and fight to the limit to survive each new horde.

Heroes

Embark on this adventure with a squad of heroes who are more than just cats. Each of our heroes has a distinct personality and a unique story. From the tough anti-hero who doesn't care about the rules to the prankster who loves a good joke. Find the hero that matches your style and save the world with a lot of personality!

Tower Strategy

Combat isn't just about shooting—it's about thinking. During battles, you can place towers that create a defensive barrier, help hold back enemy hordes, or provide crucial tactical support. Your choice of placement can change the course of the battle, turning an imminent defeat into an overwhelming victory. Your strategy is your best weapon!

Upgrades

Make your hero stronger with every victory! In your inventory, you can use the resources gained from battles to permanently enhance your hero's attributes.

Power-Ups

With each match, new choices appear. Combine power-ups, improve your weapon, and alter the fate of the battle with creative and unpredictable builds.

Face Monstrous Bosses

Prepare for the pinnacle of your journey! At the end of each series of waves, you will face a colossal boss, representing the greatest threat to your squad. Each boss has unique and complex attack patterns that require more than brute force. To defeat them, you'll need skill, quick reflexes, and impeccable planning.
